    def spawn_pipe(self):
        margin = 60

    def flap(self):

    def game_over(self):
        self.best = max(self.best, self.score)
        self.state = "over"

    def update(self):
        if self.state != "play":
            return
        self.speed, self.gap = difficulty(self.score)
        self.bird.update()
        self.spawn_timer += 1
        if self.spawn_timer >= PIPE_SPACING / self.speed:
            self.spawn_timer = 0
            self.spawn_pipe()
        for p in self.pipes:
            p.update(self.speed)
            if not p.passed and p.x + p.w < self.bird.x - self.bird.r:
                p.passed = True
                self.score += 1
        self.pipes = [p for p in self.pipes if not p.offscreen()]
        if self.bird.y + self.bird.r >= H - GROUND_H:
            self.game_over()
            return
        bird_rect = self.bird.rect
        for p in self.pipes:
            top, bottom = p.rects()
            if bird_rect.colliderect(top) or bird_rect.colliderect(bottom):
                self.game_over()
                return
